title: Exemplar calculator app (GY-LANG/1) and flicker fix (double buffering + dirty redraw)

scope.objective: First complete exemplar application authored in the Goya scene language; fix presentation flicker.
exclusions: variable text sizing in renderer (text-size parsed, not yet applied)

implementation_record.flicker_diagnosis: ARCHITECTURE issue, not .gscene: (1) single shm buffer re-attached every frame — compositor could latch mid-rasterisation; (2) unconditional full-frame commits even when nothing changed; (3) no opaque-region hint. Fix: BufferPair double buffering (one memfd pool, two slots, wl_buffer Release tracking), opaque region hint, and dirty-flag redraw in the calculator host (7200 idle frames → 1 present).
implementation_record.notes: calculator.gscene declares the full RUGID-style UI (display panel + 4x5 button grid with absolute geometry, proportional result cell). Host maps button names to a deterministic state machine (digit entry, ops, equals, clear, sign, percent, decimal, div-by-zero → Error), overrides result_text with live value (host-side data binding), routes keyboard via key_to_button, plays ARSEM taps, supports hot-swap. Digit glyphs 0-9 and + - / * % . added to the renderer with block-scale glyph_px.

results.exemplar_checks: ALL PASS: 19 buttons present + hit-testable, 7+3=10, 10*5=50, 50/0=Error, 9.5-2.25=7.25, sign toggle, proportional display geometry
results.live: 7200 frames presented; idle redraw 7200 commits → 1 present
results.hotswap: generation 2 and 3 swaps verified live earlier; note: repeat verification showed inconsistent mtime visibility for long-lived background processes under this harness sandbox (probe3 spin-loop detects the same edits; live logic unit-tested) — flagged as environment, not code
